sources.rider2016: Rider et al., PRL 117, 101101 (2016): silica r=2.5 um, permanent dipoles 151+-6, 89+-10, 192+-30 e um; UV discharge with charge quantisation. https://web.stanford.edu/group/grattalab/Publications/PhysRevLett.117.101101.pdf
sources.afek2021: Afek et al., PRA 104, 053512 (2021), arXiv:2108.04406: 15 um silica p0=(-200+-360) e um, alpha=401+-8 e um/(V/mm); precessive control cancels dipole backgrounds by x120. https://arxiv.org/abs/2108.04406
sources.priel2022: Priel et al., Sci. Adv. (2022), PMC9565793: O(100 e um) dipole signals seen in all levitated-MS techniques (7.5 um silica). https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9565793/
sources.diamond: No measured permanent dipole for levitated (micro)diamond found; rotating-diamond experiments report no observable dipole coupling (arXiv:2309.01545) -> silica surface density used (ASSUMED).
sources.lpf_patch: Armano et al., PRL 118, 171101 (2017): stray-potential fluctuations 34+-2 uV/rtHz at 1 mHz, 190+-30 at 0.1 mHz; static stray potentials up to 100 mV in lab; charging lambda_eff1+lambda_eff2 = 2220+-260 /s; UV discharge keeps V_tm within +-80 mV. https://eprints.gla.ac.uk/141213/1/141213.pdf
sources.lpf_patch_shape: Armano et al. arXiv:2404.08340: Delta_x PSD ~ 1/f (ASD ~ f^-1/2); 2-sigma limit on an extra 1/f ASD term 65 uV/rtHz x (0.1 mHz/f). https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.08340
sources.lpf_jitter: Armano et al., PRL 116, 231101 (2016): spacecraft motion bulge 20-200 mHz, max jitter 8-30 nm/rtHz on the different axes; stiffness omega_2^2 = (-525+-30)e-9 s^-2, gravitation-dominated, agrees with self-gravity model to 10%. https://journals.aps.org/prl/abstract/10.1103/PhysRevLett.116.231101
sources.lpf_release: LPF GPRM: release requirement <5 um/s; in flight typically ~10 um/s linear (Dalla Ricca et al. ESMATS 2021). https://www.esmats.eu/esmatspapers/pastpapers/pdfs/2021/dalla-ricca.pdf ; https://sci.esa.int/web/lisa-pathfinder/-/56868-lisa-pathfinder-test-mass
sources.gravitower: Prakash et al., npj Microgravity (2026): first release-recapture of optically levitated silica nanoparticles in microgravity (GraviTower Bremen); usable free flights 5-6 us, 9 us not separable. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41526-026-00596-y
sources.goce: GOCE accelerometers 2e-12 m s^-2/rtHz spec (5-100 mHz), in-flight 3.1-6.7e-12. https://sf2a.eu/proceedings/2010/2010sf2a.conf..0113C.pdf

efield.note: LPF Delta_x includes actuation-electronics noise, so it is an upper bound for a passive housing; it is the only measured space value; extrapolated from 0.1-20 mHz to ~0.3 Hz (ASSUMED shape)

charge.note: area scaling of the LPF cosmic-ray charging rate is ASSUMED; discharge to exactly 0 e by UV with charge quantisation is demonstrated in levitated microspheres (Rider 2016)
